ev.q: Descriptive analyses were performed on the nine surveys submitted.
Among the seven patients who did not receive a second course of tecovirimat, six had resolution of lesions, and one was lost to follow-up.
Among six patients for whom orthopoxvirus testing of posttreatment lesions was conducted, one received a positive result.
The median interval from mpox symptom onset to tecovirimat initiation was 9 days (range = 6–16 days).

This report describes a series of patients in New York City (NYC) with mpox who also developed new lesions after completing tecovirimat treatment
